svg.title: Requirement ledger
svg.desc: Brief requirement: Lightweight extraction path exploration, Planned proof: Bounded experiment comparing suitable HTTP/DOM work with full WebKit, compatibility documented; Brief requirement: 2× completed tasks/minute in same RAM budget, Planned proof: Identical mixed-workload baseline/candidate samples, failures included; Brief requirement: 30% lower active total physical footprint, Planned proof: Whole responsible-process family, matched workload/cache state, repeated samples; Brief requirement: 50% fewer observation tokens, Planned proof: Same tasks and reconstruction quality, explicit tokenizer or byte-only qualification; Brief requirement: p95 control latency regression no greater than 10%, Planned proof: Alternated baseline/candidate runs with sample distributions; Brief requirement: 1, 4, 8, 16, 32 clients, Planned proof: Isolation, fairness, cancellation, success and resource accounting at each level; Brief requirement: 24-hour localhost soak, Planned proof: Removed as a release requirement at the user’s explicit request on 2026-10-23; no 24-hour stability claim. Optional runner retained for future use.; Brief requirement: No task-success regression, Planned proof: Frozen task suite with denominator and baseline/candidate failure details
